name: light-speed
title: Light Speed
blurb: First-person highway rushes toward viewer with streaming car lights and road…
description: Renders a 3D WebGL highway scene using THREE.js with animated perspective, car lights, and distortion effects. Speed increases on pointer press.
use_when: Premium hero sections or pages emphasizing speed, motion, or forward momentum. Immerses viewers in kinetic energy.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts or low-end devices — WebGL rendering is GPU-intensive. Invisible on headless browsers.
a11y: WebGL visual scene with no keyboard or focus interaction. Purely visual effect without accessible alternatives.
